title: Learning Representations to Guide Pixel Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: 学习表示以引导像素扩散Transformer

paragraphs.en: 本文提出了一种“表示引导”方法，通过像素扩散Transformer研究生成任务中的视觉表示。 Visual representations are largely developed for understanding, yet what makes them useful for generation remains unclear. We study this question in pixel diffusion transformers and uncover two key insights. First, better representation quality does not necessarily translate into greater generative utility, as externally aligned semantics can be progressively lost during pixel synthesis. Second, architectural separation with specialized pixel decoders mainly redistributes semantic and spatial modeling, without necessarily yielding representations better suited to generation. These insights suggest that a useful generative representation must be both properly formed and actively exploited. Motivated by these insights, we introduce Representation Guidance (RG), which directly forms and exploits internal representations while retaining a plain Transformer architecture. A low-dimensional bottleneck forces generation-relevant information into a compact representation, which is then explicitly used to guide decoder generation by modifying the flow-matching target according to its induced prediction offset. RG learns clearer semantic and spatial structure while scaling efficiently in both parameters and computation. On ImageNet 256x256, RG-L/16 with only 459M parameters outperforms substantially larger pixel diffusion transformers, while RG-XL/16 achieves an FID of 1.55. RG further reaches an FID of 1.74 at 512x512 and extends to text-to-image generation, achieving 0.89 on GenEval and 87.1 on DPG-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一种“表示引导”方法，通过像素扩散Transformer生成任务中的视觉表示。视觉表示主要用于理解，但究竟是什么使其对生成任务有用，这一点仍不清楚。 我们在像素扩散Transformer中研究了这个问题，并发现了两个关键见解。 首先，更高的表示质量并不必然意味着更强的生成能力，因为外部对齐的语义信息在像素合成过程中可能会逐渐丢失。 其次，采用专用像素解码器的架构分离主要只是重新分配了语义建模和空间建模的任务，而未必能产生更适合生成的表示。 这些见解表明，一个有用的生成表示必须既被正确构建，又能被主动利用。 基于这些见解，我们提出了“表示引导”（Representation Guidance，RG）方法，它在保留普通Transformer架构的同时，直接构建并利用内部表示。 一个低维瓶颈迫使与生成相关的信息浓缩为紧凑的表示，随后通过根据该表示引发的预测偏移量修改流匹配目标，明确地用于指导解码器的生成过程。 RG在提升语义和空间结构清晰度的同时，还能在参数和计算效率方面实现高效扩展。 在ImageNet 256x256数据集上，仅含4.59亿参数的RG-L/16就显著优于规模大得多的像素扩散Transformer，而RG-XL/16的FID值达到了1.55。 RG在512x512分辨率下进一步将FID值提升至1.74，并成功扩展至文本到图像生成任务，在GenEval上取得了0.89的成绩，在DPG-Bench上获得了87.1分。
